bm_units.description: One row per Balancing Mechanism unit that can generate (interconnector units are in the Interconnects family). Registration and machine data from Elexon; the statistics of its notified dynamics and metered output are in bm_dynamics. profile_id is 'gen-bmu-' plus the slug of the Elexon id.

fields.name: profile_id
fields.description: Stable profile identifier (see the table description for its form).

fields.name: profile_rev
fields.description: Revision of this profile. It stays the same while the profile's content is unchanged and goes up by one when any value changes, so profile_id@profile_rev always means one fixed set of values.
fields.source: derived: previous build's revision and content_sha256

fields.name: content_sha256
fields.description: SHA-256 of the profile's values (every field except profile_rev, content_sha256 and last_updated_utc, floats by their exact bits). Used to decide when profile_rev goes up.

fields.name: source_dataset
fields.description: Lake dataset the row was built from.

fields.name: source_key
fields.description: Elexon BM unit id, or 'ng:' plus the National Grid id where Elexon has no registration.

fields.name: last_updated_utc
fields.description: Profiles last updated: the date these profiles were brought up to.

fields.name: bmu_id
fields.description: Elexon BM unit id; for a unit NESO lists without an Elexon registration, 'ng:' plus its National Grid id.

fields.name: ng_bmu_id
fields.description: NESO (National Grid) BM unit id.

fields.name: unit_name
fields.description: BM unit name as registered.

fields.name: lead_party
fields.description: Registered lead party.

fields.name: bmu_type
fields.description: Elexon BM unit type (T transmission, E embedded, I interconnector, S supplier, V virtual and so on).

fields.name: fuel_type
fields.description: Elexon fuel type (CCGT, OCGT, NUCLEAR, WIND, BIOMASS and so on). Null for most embedded and supplier units: Elexon publishes no fuel for them.

fields.name: fuel_folder
fields.description: Profiles folder under Generator.
fields.source: derived: fuel_type via the builder's FUEL table

fields.name: gsp_group
fields.description: GSP group name.

fields.name: transmission_loss_factor
fields.description: Transmission loss factor applied in settlement.

fields.name: capacity_mw
fields.description: Registered generation capacity.

fields.name: rated_mva_assumed
fields.description: [VERIFY] Machine MVA base for per-unit values (pu@machine, H): capacity_mw / 0.9, using the power factor GDA's inertia work assumes. Assumed, not published: replace when a published MVA rating is found.

fields.name: demand_capacity_mw
fields.description: Registered demand capacity (negative or zero for generators; storage and pumped units import).

fields.name: max_rating_mw
fields.description: Estimated maximum rating, on the rule that nameplate capacity is 80% of the machine's maximum: capacity / 0.8.

fields.name: thermal_headroom_mw
fields.description: Estimated thermal headroom above nameplate: max_rating_mw minus capacity.

fields.name: inertia_h_s
fields.description: [VERIFY] Typical inertia constant H for the fuel, on the machine's own MVA base, from GDA's documented table (Scripts/build_inertia_reconstructed.py H_BY_FUEL: NESO, ENTSO-E and classical machine ranges). Null for converter-connected plant, which adds no true inertia.

fields.name: stored_energy_s_mva
fields.description: [VERIFY] Kinetic energy at rated speed: inertia_h_s x rated_mva_assumed.

fields.name: pole_count
fields.description: [VERIFY] Number of generator poles. Not held in the lake; reserved for a future source.

fields.name: rated_speed_rpm
fields.description: [VERIFY] Rated shaft speed (120 x 50 / pole_count). Not held in the lake; set when pole_count is known.

fields.name: rated_torque_knm
fields.description: [VERIFY] Rated shaft torque (rated MW / shaft angular speed). Not held in the lake; set when rated speed is known.

fields.name: co2_t_per_mwh
fields.description: [VERIFY] Emission intensity of this asset. The lake holds only regional grid intensity, not per-asset figures; reserved for a future source.

fields.name: named_operator
fields.description: [VERIFY] Operator or owner of the asset, from Generator/names.csv (named by hand, not published). Null where not named.

fields.name: named_site
fields.description: [VERIFY] Site name, from Generator/names.csv. Null where not named.

fields.name: named_address
fields.description: [VERIFY] Site address, from Generator/names.csv. Null where not named.

fields.name: named_by
fields.description: [VERIFY] Who named the asset and when, from Generator/names.csv.

fields.name: quality_flags
fields.description: Semicolon list of issues (for example no_fuel_type, no_capacity, no_elexon_registration). Empty when none.

bm_dynamics.description: Statistics of each BM unit's notified dynamic parameters (ramp rates, stable and maximum limits, notice and run times) and metered output, over the 365 days to the last-updated date. Kept apart from bm_units because they come from time-stamped operational data. profile_id is 'gen-dyn-' plus the slug of the Elexon id.

fields.name: profile_id
fields.description: Stable profile identifier (see the table description for its form).

fields.name: profile_rev
fields.description: Revision of this profile. It stays the same while the profile's content is unchanged and goes up by one when any value changes, so profile_id@profile_rev always means one fixed set of values.
fields.source: derived: previous build's revision and content_sha256

fields.name: content_sha256
fields.description: SHA-256 of the profile's values (every field except profile_rev, content_sha256 and last_updated_utc, floats by their exact bits). Used to decide when profile_rev goes up.

fields.name: source_dataset
fields.description: Elexon datasets the statistics come from.

fields.name: source_key
fields.description: Elexon BM unit id.

fields.name: last_updated_utc
fields.description: Profiles last updated: the date these profiles were brought up to.

fields.name: bmu_id
fields.description: Elexon BM unit id; for a unit NESO lists without an Elexon registration, 'ng:' plus its National Grid id.

fields.name: fuel_folder
fields.description: Profiles folder under Generator (as in bm_units).

fields.name: dynamics_window_start_utc
fields.description: Start of the 365-day window the statistics use.

fields.name: ramp_up_mw_per_min_p50
fields.description: Median of the fastest notified run-up rate (the largest of the three RURE rate bands per notification).

fields.name: ramp_up_mw_per_min_p90
fields.description: 90th percentile of the fastest notified run-up rate.

fields.name: ramp_up_slowest_mw_per_min_p50
fields.description: Median of the slowest run-up band per notification (the rate near the elbows).

fields.name: ramp_down_mw_per_min_p50
fields.description: Median of the fastest notified run-down rate.

fields.name: ramp_down_mw_per_min_p90
fields.description: 90th percentile of the fastest notified run-down rate.

fields.name: ramp_down_slowest_mw_per_min_p50
fields.description: Median of the slowest run-down band per notification.

fields.name: import_ramp_up_mw_per_min_p50
fields.description: Median fastest run-up rate on import (storage and pumped units).

fields.name: import_ramp_down_mw_per_min_p50
fields.description: Median fastest run-down rate on import.

fields.name: ramp_notifications
fields.description: Run-up and run-down export notifications in the window.

fields.name: stable_export_limit_mw_p50
fields.description: Median stable export limit (the lowest steady output).

fields.name: stable_import_limit_mw_p50
fields.description: Median stable import limit.

fields.name: max_export_limit_mw_max
fields.description: Highest maximum export limit notified in the window.

fields.name: max_export_limit_mw_p50
fields.description: Median maximum export limit notified.

fields.name: notice_to_deviate_min_p50
fields.description: Median notice needed to move from zero output.

fields.name: min_zero_time_min_p50
fields.description: Median minimum time the unit must stay at zero once there.

fields.name: min_non_zero_time_min_p50
fields.description: Median minimum time the unit must run once started.

fields.name: metered_periods
fields.description: Half-hours with a metered output value in the window.

fields.name: output_mw_mean
fields.description: Mean metered output (B1610 energy per half-hour x 2).

fields.name: output_mw_p50
fields.description: Median metered output (nearest rank on 0.1 MW bins).

fields.name: output_mw_p99
fields.description: 99th percentile of metered output (nearest rank on 0.1 MW bins).

fields.name: output_mw_max
fields.description: Highest metered output.

fields.name: capacity_factor
fields.description: output_mw_mean / capacity_mw.

fields.name: dynamics_window_end_utc
fields.description: End of the window: the profiles last-updated date.

fields.name: named_operator
fields.description: [VERIFY] Operator or owner of the asset, from Generator/names.csv (named by hand, not published). Null where not named.

fields.name: named_site
fields.description: [VERIFY] Site name, from Generator/names.csv. Null where not named.

fields.name: named_address
fields.description: [VERIFY] Site address, from Generator/names.csv. Null where not named.

fields.name: named_by
fields.description: [VERIFY] Who named the asset and when, from Generator/names.csv.

fields.name: quality_flags
fields.description: Semicolon list of issues (no_metered_output, no_dynamic_data; ramp_rate_999_notified: the unit notifies 999 MW/min, the convention for no ramp limit, kept as published; output_above_rule_max_rating: metered output above capacity / 0.8). Empty when none.

stations.description: One row per generating station from DESNZ DUKES 5.11 and the Renewable Energy Planning Database (REPD). REPD rows are kept when the project is operational or still live (Operational, Under Construction, Awaiting Construction, Application Submitted, Appeal Lodged, No Application Required), so the table also serves forward planning; refused, withdrawn, abandoned, expired, revised and decommissioned records are left out. Each source's latest snapshot dated on or before the last-updated date is used. profile_id is 'gen-dukes-' or 'gen-repd-' plus the source key.
